QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r1.speaker: الشاعر
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r1.claim: A poetic simile compares a woman's movement while walking to the shaking of a leafy branch, illustrating plant-like movement.
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r1.anchor: تثنى إذا قامت وتهتز إن مشت كما اهتز غصن البان في ورق خضر

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r2.claim: Rabat means rose, increased, or swelled; these explanations converge on increase, from the root r-b-w.
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r2.anchor: { وربت } أي ارتفعت وزادت. وقيل: انتفخت والمعنى واحد، وأصله الزيادة

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r3.speaker: يزيد بن القعقاع وخالد بن الياس
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r3.claim: Yazid ibn al-Qa'qa and Khalid ibn Ilyas read raba'at with hamza, meaning it rose like a lookout on high ground; the derivative names the watchman.
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r3.anchor: وقرأ يزيد بن القعقاع وخالد بن الياس «وربأت» أي ارتفعت حتى صارت بمنزلة الربيئة

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r4.speaker: امرؤ القيس
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r4.claim: Imru al-Qays's line about sending a lookout witnesses the sense of rabī'a as a scout stationed above.
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r4.anchor: قال امرؤ القيس: بعثنا ربيئا قبل ذاك مخملا كذئب الغضا

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r5.claim: Anbatat means the earth brought forth growth.

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r6.claim: Zawj here means a color or kind.

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r7.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r7.claim: Qatada glosses bahij as beautiful and pleasing to whoever sees it.
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r7.anchor: { بهيج } أي حسن عن قتادة. أي يبهج من يراه

QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r8.claim: Because the verse says the earth produces growth, Qurtubi concludes that 'shook and swelled' describes the earth, not the plants.
QURTUBI-FULL:22:5#8/r8.anchor: ولما وصف الأرض بالإنبات دل على أن قوله: «اهتزت وربت» يرجع إلى الأرض

BURSEVI:v6p3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3/r1.claim: Strive day and night to purify the soul and subdue denial: this greater struggle faces the inward enemy that is hardest to evade.
BURSEVI:v6p3/r1.anchor: فعلى العاقل الاجتهاد في الليل والنهار لتزكية النفس وقمع الإنكار فإنه جهاد أكبر

BURSEVI:v6p3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3/r2.claim: The author asks God to protect from enemies and make people follow the clear truth from which there is no deviation.
BURSEVI:v6p3/r2.anchor: نسأل الله سبحانه أن يحفظنا من شر الأعداء ويجعلنا تابعين للحق الصريح الذي لا محيد عنه

BURSEVI:v6p3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3/r3.claim: The address is to the people of Mecca who deny resurrection.

BURSEVI:v6p3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3/r4.claim: Baʿth means bringing people out of the earth and conveying them to the gathering place.
BURSEVI:v6p3/r4.anchor: البعث الإخراج من الأرض والتسيير إلى الموقف

BURSEVI:v6p3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3/r5.claim: The conditional إن appears despite many doubters because the evidence here uproots doubt and frames it as merely hypothetical.
BURSEVI:v6p3/r5.anchor: وجيء بأن مع كثرة المرتابين لاشتمال المقام على ما يقلع الريب من أصله

BURSEVI:v6p3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3/r6.claim: Doubt concerns either whether restoration is possible and within God’s power, or whether resurrection will occur.
BURSEVI:v6p3/r6.anchor: إن كنتم في شك من إمكان الإعادة وكونها مقدورة له تعالى أو من وقوعها

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r1.claim: The creation clause is not the conditional answer, since creation preceded doubt; it is evidence for an omitted answer: consider your origin and doubt will disappear.
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r1.anchor: ليس جزاء للشرط لأن خلقهم مقدم على كونهم مرتابين بل هو علة للجزاء المحذوف

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r2.claim: Humanity was first created collectively from dust through Adam.

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r3.speaker: النبي
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r3.claim: A hadith says God made the earth tractable beneath people and created humans from dust to humble them; they instead chose arrogance, and pride bars entry to Paradise.
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r3.anchor: وفي الحديث : "إن الله جعل الأرض ذلولا تمشون في مناكبها وخلق بني آدم من تراب ليذلهم بذلك

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r4.claim: Nuṭfah is clear water, little or much, and by extension male semen; the name derives from water flowing or being poured.
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r4.anchor: هي الماء الصافي قل أو كثر ويعبر بها عن ماء الرجل

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r5.claim: ʿAlaqah is a clotted piece of blood formed from semen.
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r5.anchor: قطعة من الدم جامدة مكونة من المني

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r6.claim: Muḍghah is a piece of flesh formed from clot, originally the amount that can be chewed.
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r6.anchor: أي قطعة من اللحم مكونة من العلق وهي في الأصل مقدار ما يمضغ

BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r7.claim: Mukhallaqah is genitive as an adjective modifying muḍghah.
BURSEVI:v6p3#2/r7.anchor: بالجر صفة مضغة أي مستبينة الخلق مصورة

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r1.speaker: الإرشاد
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r1.claim: Al-Irshād says an unformed morsel has no distinct shape yet: first no limbs are visible, then some appear; the last state is “unformed” as a privation.
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r1.anchor: لم يستبن خلقها وصورتها بعد والمراد تفصيل حال المضغة

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r2.speaker: التأويلات
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r2.claim: The Najmī inward reading calls the formed morsel one into which the spirit has been breathed and the unformed one an image without a soul.

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r3.claim: A hadith says each person’s creation is gathered in the mother’s womb for forty days; gathering is securing the material of creation, and “womb” names the whole for a part.

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd reports that the drop spreads beneath the woman’s skin, nails, and hair, stays forty nights, descends as blood, then becomes a clot and morsel for equivalent periods before the spirit is breathed in.
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r4.anchor: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن النطفة إذا وقعت في الرحم فأراد الله أن يخلق منها

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r5.claim: In Ibn Masʿūd’s report, an angel is sent to write provision, lifespan, deeds, and whether the person is destined for misery or happiness.
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r5.anchor: يعني يؤمر الملك بكتابة أربع من القضايا وكل قضية سميت كلمة

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r6.claim: The report suggests image formation in the second forty days, but the author says this means it is then decreed, since visible formation normally follows the morsel stage.
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r6.anchor: وهذا يدل على أن التصوير يكون في الأربعين الثاني لكن المراد تقدير تصويرها

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r7.claim: The miserable person is destined for the Fire and the happy person for Paradise; misery is mentioned first because most people fall into that class.

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r8.claim: God created people through these remarkable stages to clarify resurrection: whoever first created humans from lifeless dust can restore them.
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r8.anchor: أي خلقناكم على هذا النمط البديع لنبين لكم بذلك أمر البعث والنشور

BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r9.claim: The cited couplets make the same inference: the One able to create people initially has manifest power to resurrect them.
BURSEVI:v6p3#3/r9.anchor: بعث إنسان كرنشد عيان أول خلقش هذا بيان

BURSEVI:v6p4/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r1.claim: This begins a new clause describing what God wills to keep in the womb after creation, until a set term.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r1.anchor: استئناف مسوق لبيان حالهم بعد تمام خلقهم

BURSEVI:v6p4/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r2.claim: The term is delivery; its minimum is six months by agreement, while jurists differ on its maximum.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r2.anchor: وقت معين هو وقت الوضع وأدناه ستة أشهر عند الكل

BURSEVI:v6p4/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r3.speaker: أبو حنيفة
BURSEVI:v6p4/r3.claim: Abū Ḥanīfa sets the maximum pregnancy term at two years.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r3.anchor: وأقصاه سنتان عند أبي حنيفة رحمه الله

BURSEVI:v6p4/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r4.speaker: الشافعي
BURSEVI:v6p4/r4.claim: Al-Shāfiʿī sets the maximum pregnancy term at four years.

BURSEVI:v6p4/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r5.speaker: مالك
BURSEVI:v6p4/r5.claim: Mālik sets the maximum pregnancy term at five years.

BURSEVI:v6p4/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r6.speaker: الضحاك بن مزاحم
BURSEVI:v6p4/r6.claim: The Successor al-Ḍaḥḥāk ibn Muzāḥim is reported to have remained in the womb for two years.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r6.anchor: روي : أن الضحاك بن مزاحم التابعي مكث في بطن أمه سنتين

BURSEVI:v6p4/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r7.speaker: مالك
BURSEVI:v6p4/r7.claim: Mālik is reported to have remained in the womb three years; al-Suyūṭī mentions this alongside the report about al-Ḍaḥḥāk.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r7.anchor: ومالكا ثلاث سنين كما ذكره السيوطي

BURSEVI:v6p4/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r8.speaker: الإمام
BURSEVI:v6p4/r8.claim: The Imām reports that a neighbor bore three children in twelve years, with four years of pregnancy each time.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r8.anchor: وأخبر الإمام رحمه الله أن جارة له ولدت ثلاثة أولاد في اثنتي عشرة سنة تحمل أربع سنين

BURSEVI:v6p4/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r9.claim: Some pregnancies are not retained after development is complete and end in miscarriage.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r9.anchor: وفيه إشارة إلى أن بعض ما في الأرحام لا يشاء الله تعالى إقراره فيها بعد تكامل خلقه فيسقط

BURSEVI:v6p4/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r10.claim: At the end of the fixed term, God brings people out from their mothers’ wombs.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r10.anchor: أي من بطون أمهاتكم بعد إقراركم فيها عند تمام الأجل المسمى

BURSEVI:v6p4/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r11.claim: The singular ṭiflan applies to each child or is a generic form covering one or many.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r11.anchor: والأفراد باعتبار كل واحد منهم أو بإرادة الجنس المنتظم للواحد والمتعدد

BURSEVI:v6p4/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r12.claim: Ṭifl refers to a soft, tender child.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r12.anchor: والطفل الولد ما دام ناعما كما في "المفردات"

BURSEVI:v6p4/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r13.speaker: المولى الفناري
BURSEVI:v6p4/r13.claim: Al-Fanārī defines the child stage as birth and first cry through the end of six years.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r13.anchor: وقال المولى الفناري في تفسير الفاتحة حد الطفل من أول ما يولد إلى أن يستهل صارخا إلى انقضاء ستة أعوام

BURSEVI:v6p4/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r14.claim: The purpose of reaching maturity is coordinated with the purpose of bringing people out: they grow gradually to adulthood.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r14.anchor: علة لنخرجكم معطوفة على علة أخرى مناسبة لها كأنه قيل ثم نخرجكم

BURSEVI:v6p4/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r15.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p4/r15.claim: Reaching full strength means completeness in power, reason, and discernment, usually between thirty and forty.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r15.anchor: كما لكم في القوة والعقل والتمييز وهو فيما بين الثلاثين والأربعين

BURSEVI:v6p4/r16.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p4/r16.speaker: القاموس
BURSEVI:v6p4/r16.claim: Al-Qāmūs gives ashudd as eighteen to thirty years and notes its singular form follows a plural pattern like ānuk.
BURSEVI:v6p4/r16.anchor: وفي "القاموس" : ما بين ثماني عشرة إلى ثلاثين واحد جاء على بناء الجمع كآنك ولا نظير لهما

NASHR:v2p325/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p325/r2.speaker: أبو جعفر
NASHR:v2p325/r2.claim: Abu Ja'far reads rabat with an added open hamza after bāʾ in both this verse and Fussilat; the others omit it.
NASHR:v2p325/r2.anchor: فقرأ أبو جعفر (ربأت) بهمزة مفتوحة بعد الباء في الموضعين
